$comment: Single source of truth for the Breadcrumb API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: The trail of pages above this one, so people can see where they are and go back up.

items.description: The trail, top first. The last item is this page (no href).

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Links up the trail; the current page is plain text.

examples.title: Chevron
examples.description: A chevron between items instead of a slash.

examples.title: Long names
examples.description: Names longer than 22 characters are cut with an ellipsis; the full name is in the title attribute.

a11y: A <nav> named "Breadcrumb", with an ordered list inside, so screen readers announce a breadcrumb landmark and the number of levels.
The separators are drawn by CSS with empty alternative text, so they aren't read out.
